schools.heroLead: Amy Surfwing guides children through the digital world — with stories, reflection tasks and daily prompts that genuinely engage pupils.
schools.bigStatement: Children are growing up in a digital world. Schools can walk alongside them, not with rules, but with good experiences.
schools.learnIntro: Each episode guides children through a real digital everyday situation: they decide, experience consequences and reflect. This is what real media education looks like.
schools.learn1: Perspective-taking: understanding digital situations from different points of view
schools.learn2: Judgement: assessing online situations and forming one's own opinion
schools.learn3: Responsibility: thinking through the consequences of one's actions online
schools.learn4: Self-efficacy: experiencing that one's own decisions make a difference
schools.how1: School receives Season Codes for all pupils
schools.how2: Optional: introductory session by AYM on-site
schools.how3: Use on school devices or personal tablets
schools.dsgvo1: All progress data stays exclusively on the device.
schools.dsgvo2: No account, no cloud, no data sent to AYM Vision.
schools.dsgvo3: No installation required — runs directly in the browser.
schools.pilotText: Our first school pilot is launching soon: with fourth-grade pupils we are exploring how media education with Amy works in the classroom and how we can keep improving.

orgs.hero: Codes for children. Simple and direct.
orgs.heroLead: Whether library, company or association — Season Codes let you give children access to Amy Surfwing without any technical effort.
orgs.bigStatement: Every child deserves access to good digital experiences. Together we can make that happen.
orgs.usecase1Body: As a digital offering for children and families — at the library or to take home.
orgs.usecase2Body: As a meaningful employee gift for families — valuable and sustainable.
orgs.usecase3Body: As a leisure activity for members — at children's events or as part of membership.
orgs.usecase4Body: Codes for children from disadvantaged families — targeted and straightforward.
orgs.currentTitle: Media literacy for children in Gifhorn
orgs.currentText: In four Advent events at different locations across Gifhorn, we are piloting Amy Surfwing together with public libraries — with families, children and education professionals in active exchange.
orgs.how1: You receive Season Codes to pass on to families.
orgs.how2: Each code unlocks Season 1 on one device.
orgs.how3: No app installation required — runs directly in the browser.
orgs.fact4: Codes delivered by email after payment
